note: Written by reference/ledgerd-client/scripts/gen-authres-conformance.ts from the TypeScript oracle (src/mail/authres.ts); do not hand-edit. Each vector is one header block: `headers`, or `headers_parts` (concatenate each part's `text` repeated `repeat` times). `provider` is "outlook" for an Outlook.com vector and absent for a Gmail one. `expect` is that provider's verdict {trusted, reason} and verified domain (gmailVerdict / outlookVerdict, verifiedDomain). All inputs are synthetic. See README.md.
